postings.title: Senior Principal Analog/Mixed-Signal Architect – Optical Connectivity & Customer Solutions
top_requirements: Design and verify high‑performance analog/mixed‑signal front‑ends for optical connectivity, including transimpedance amplifiers, clock data recovery circuits, and equalizers.
Lead architecture trade‑offs for noise, linearity (IIP3), power, and area across 28 nm‑plus CMOS processes while collaborating with layout and verification teams.
Develop and execute silicon bring‑up, measurement, and debug plans using high‑speed test equipment (VNA, BERT, eye‑diagram) to validate link budgets and compliance with industry standards.
postings.summary: The role focuses on creating analog and mixed‑signal IP for optical interconnects, a natural fit for a senior engineer with RF and modem design experience looking to move into high‑performance IC design. Marvell’s scale offers a compensation package that meets the candidate’s target.

postings.title: Digital - Principal Systems/DSP Engineer
top_requirements: Define the end‑to‑end DSP architecture for 224 Gb/s and 448 Gb/s SerDes, including channel modeling, equalization, and clock‑data‑recovery algorithms.
Develop and validate CDR and adaptive equalizer algorithms in MATLAB/Simulink and port them to high‑performance C/C++ for silicon implementation on 3 nm/2 nm nodes.
Collaborate with layout, silicon validation, and test teams to bring up prototype silicon, perform eye‑diagram analysis, and iterate on algorithm parameters for optimal BER performance.
postings.summary: Eliyan’s principal systems/DSP engineer role drives the core DSP for next‑generation high‑speed SerDes, aligning with the candidate’s background in communications and modem design while offering a hands‑on, startup environment.

postings.title: DSP Integration Test Engineer
top_requirements: Lead bring‑up and integration of high‑speed DSP cores on early‑stage prototype boards, including firmware loading, clock configuration, and signal path verification.
Develop automated test suites in Python/C to validate transmit and receive DSP functions against link‑budget specifications for intra‑DCI applications.
Troubleshoot hardware‑DSP interactions, perform eye‑diagram and constellation analysis, and iterate on firmware to achieve target BER and latency goals.
postings.summary: The DSP Integration Test Engineer position at AttoTude offers hands‑on work bringing up modem‑level DSP on prototype hardware, directly leveraging the candidate’s communications and test experience in a small, innovative company.

postings.title: Principal ASIC Engineer (Mixed-Signal)
top_requirements: Lead mixed‑signal ASIC design for silicon‑photonic FMCW LiDAR front‑ends, including transimpedance amplifiers, phase‑locked loops, and high‑speed ADC/DAC blocks.
Perform full‑chip simulation, corner analysis, and layout‑aware verification to meet stringent noise, linearity, and power‑budget targets.
Drive silicon bring‑up, measurement, and debug of photonic‑electronic co‑design prototypes using high‑frequency test equipment and custom firmware.
postings.summary: Voyant Photonics seeks a principal ASIC engineer to create mixed‑signal chips for next‑gen LiDAR, a role that matches the candidate’s RF/modem background while moving into cutting‑edge photonic ICs in a fast‑growing startup.

postings.title: Analog Mixed-Signal Circuit Design Engineer (Remote)
top_requirements: Design analog and mixed‑signal voltage regulator circuits across multiple CMOS nodes, meeting specifications for noise, load regulation, and efficiency.
Create detailed schematic and layout designs, run corner and Monte‑Carlo simulations, and generate design documentation for silicon tape‑out.
Develop and execute silicon validation plans, including bench testing of regulator performance, transient response, and EMI compliance.
postings.summary: Ferric’s analog mixed‑signal circuit design engineer role focuses on advanced voltage regulator IP, offering a hands‑on IC design opportunity that aligns with the candidate’s experience in high‑performance analog/RF design, within a small, innovative company.
